challenges.name: templates-types-quiz
challenges.title: Predict it: string templates, inferred types and integer arithmetic
challenges.description: Read a push-notification template the way the compiler does, then decide which lines about Kotlin's number types are true.

questions.question:
What does this print?

data class CartItem(val name: String, val qty: Int)

val item = CartItem("Rau muong", 2)
println("$item.qty x ${item.name}")
questions.explanation: A template without braces takes only the longest identifier after the $: $item. The text .qty that follows is plain text, not a property access. item is a data class, so its toString() is CartItem(name=Rau muong, qty=2), and the line becomes CartItem(name=Rau muong, qty=2).qty x Rau muong. ${item.name} has braces, so the whole expression item.name is evaluated. To print 2 x Rau muong, write ${item.qty}. It compiles: item is a valid reference, and nothing about .qty is checked because it is just text.

options.text: CartItem(name=Rau muong, qty=2).qty x Rau muong
It does not compile: a template needs braces around item.qty

questions.question: Which of these statements are true? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: An integer literal that does not fit in an Int is a Long, so 3_000_000_000 is inferred as Long without an L. 7 / 2 divides two Ints, which truncates to 3. A val cannot be reassigned, but the list it refers to is still a MutableList, so cart.add("ca") compiles and changes the list. val total: Long = qty * 15_000 does not compile: qty * 15_000 is an Int, and Kotlin never widens an Int to a Long for you ("Initializer type mismatch: expected 'Long', actual 'Int'"); write qty.toLong() * 15_000. 10 / 0.0 is a Double division and gives Infinity; only integer division by zero throws ArithmeticException. Int.MAX_VALUE + 1 does not throw either: Int arithmetic wraps around silently to -2147483648.

options.text: val big = 3_000_000_000 compiles, and big is a Long
val qty = 3 followed by val total: Long = qty * 15_000 compiles
val cart = mutableListOf("rau") followed by cart.add("ca") compiles
println(Int.MAX_VALUE + 1) throws an exception because the result overflows

challenges.name: checkout-summary
challenges.title: Write the checkout summary with the free-shipping bar
challenges.description: The Cho Xanh checkout screen shows each cart line, the subtotal, the delivery fee and how far the customer is from free shipping. Write lineTotal, shippingFee and freeShippingProgress so that wholesale orders do not overflow, an empty cart pays nothing, a cart of exactly 300,000 VND ships free, and the progress bar shows a real percentage instead of 0. The test runner reads one cart line per line and prints the summary.

THIT-07 1 185000 Thit bo Uc

1 x Thit bo Uc: 185000 VND

total: 260000 VND
